'''Label''' is a small [[Oceanic language]] spoken on [[New Ireland (island)|New Ireland]] in Papua New Guinea. It is one of many [[Meso-Melanesian languages]] spoken on the island. The Label language is largely spoken on the south west of the island in a small pocket of space.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Language distribution maps {{!}} Languages of Papua New Guinea |url=https://pnglanguages.sil.org/resources/provinces/province/New%20Ireland/map |access-date=2025-09-28 |website=pnglanguages.sil.org}}</ref> It is not known to be spoken in any significant way outside of Papua New Guinea.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Label language resources {{!}} Joshua Project |url=https://joshuaproject.net/languages/lbb#details |access-date=2025-09-28 |website=joshuaproject.net}}</ref>

There are few speakers of the language, and is thus, endangered.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Label Language (LBB) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered Level & Official Use {{!}} Ethnologue Free |url=https://www.ethnologue.com/language/lbb/ |access-date=2025-09-28 |website=Ethnologue (Free All) |language=en}}</ref> Estimates vary between 140 (from a 1979 survey), up to 500 speakers.<ref name=":0" /> In 2005, the language was considered to be on the brink of extinction by som, with about 300 speakers.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Saved from the brink of extinction |url=https://wycliffe.org.uk/story/saved-from-the-brink-of-extinction |access-date=2025-09-28 |website=Wycliffe Bible Translators |language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Resources ==
On 24 November 2024, the Label community came together to celebrate the launch of the Label New Testament. Until this translation, the Label language was an oral only language. Thus, to create the biblical text, an alphabet had to be created. At the launch event, there was a celebration with speeches, prayers, dancing, meals and a devotional message, accompanied by readings from the newly produced New Testament.<ref name=":1" />

The New Testament in Label is available on the [[YouVersion]] Bible app, one of 1,600 languages on the app.<ref>{{Cite book |url=https://www.bible.com/versions/1396-lbb-label |title=Download Label {{!}} lbb Bible {{!}} 100% Free}}</ref>

Furthermore, the Jesus Film is available to watch online in the Label language.<ref>{{Cite web |title=JESUS |url=https://www.jesusfilm.org/watch/watch/jesus.html/label.html |access-date=2025-09-28 |website=jesusfilm.org}}{{dead link|date=May 2026}}</ref>
